english.title: Keeper of bovine animal in Wales fail to comply with notice served by veterinary inspector under article 10(3)
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the keeper of a bovine animal, namely **(..SPECIFY ANIMAL..), and having been served with a notice by a veterinary inspector under article 10(3) of the Tuberculosis (Wales) Order 2010 requiring you to

(A)_[detain that animal in accordance with the requirements of the notice and keep it isolated from other bovine animals,]_
(B)_[take steps to ensure that the milk produced by the animal was not mixed with other milk and was not fed untreated to calves or to other mammals and was boiled or pasteurised or otherwise sterilised if not otherwise discarded, and that any utensil with which such milk had been in contact before it was so treated was thoroughly cleansed and scalded with steam or boiling water before the utensil was used again,]_
(C)_[ensure that no bovine animal was moved on to or off the premises or such part of the premises as was specified in the notice except under the authority of a licence issued by an inspector,]_
(D)_[**(..COMBINATION OF THE ABOVE..),]_

failed to do so in that **(..SPECIFY FAILURE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to article 10(3) of the Tuberculosis (Wales) Order 2010 and sections 73 and 75 of the Animal Health Act 1981.

welsh.welshoffencetitle: Ceidwad anifail buchol yng Nghymru wedi methu â chydymffurfio â hysbysiad gan arolygydd milfeddygol o dan erthygl 10(3)
welsh.welshstandardoffencewording:
"Ar **(..SPECIFY DATE..) yn **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), a chithau’n geidwad anifail buchol, sef **(..SPECIFY ANIMAL..), ac wedi i arolygydd milfeddygol gyflwyno hysbysiad arnoch o dan erthygl 10(3) Gorchymyn Twbercwlosis (Cymru) 2010 a oedd yn mynnu eich bod yn
(A)_[cadw’r anifail hwnnw yn unol â gofynion yr hysbysiad ac yn ei gadw ar wahân i anifeiliaid buchol eraill,]_
(B)_[cymryd camau i sicrhau nad oedd y llaeth a gynhyrchwyd gan yr anifail yn cael ei gymysgu gyda llaeth arall ac nad oedd yn cael ei roi heb ei drin i loeau neu i famaliaid eraill a’i fod wedi’i ferwi neu ei basteureiddio neu ei sterileiddio os nad oedd wedi’i waredu mewn rhyw ffordd arall, a bod unrhyw declyn a oedd wedi cyffwrdd y llaeth hwnnw cyn iddo gael ei drin wedi cael ei lanhau gyda stêm neu ddŵr berwedig cyn i’r teclyn gael ei ddefnyddio eto,]_
(C)_[sicrhau nad oedd yr un anifail buchol yn cael ei symud i’r eiddo neu o’r eiddo neu unrhyw ran o’r eiddo fel y’i nodwyd yn yr hysbysiad heblaw gydag awdurdod trwydded a roddwyd gan arolygydd,]_
(D)_[**(..COMBINATION OF THE ABOVE..),]_bu ichi fethu â gwneud hynny oherwydd **(..SPECIFY FAILURE..)"

other.penalty:
Summary: maximum 6 months imprisonment and/or a fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
